source.description: Welcome to #Solarpunk USA, a guide to creating a solarpunk future. Solarpunk is much more than #art , its a lifestyle we can have now or very soon if we learn how to organize our #communities with direct involvement from everyone. Solarpunk art used in these video: Free Association ~ By Sean Bodley Communal Garden ~ By Sean Bodley City of Edmonton Perkins Wills Artists Drawing The Fifth Sacred Thing by Jessica Perlstein Solarpunk train, possibly an ai from german article https://www.tagesschau.de/wissen/klima/solarpunk-klimaoptimismus-100.html?utm_source=pocket-newtab-de-de Solarpunk community by Robin Guinin Solarpunk Wallpaper -bettyschlackman Cozy PC setup - @matcha.mage Email: solarpunkUSA@ proton.me Also please support me on patreon https://www.patreon.com/Anubis2814 Mastodon (fediverse): solarpunkusa@friendica.myportal.social SolarpunkUSA on bluesky
